# ROC webinar landing page, preview

Preview build of the Rheumatologist OnCall registration page for the free live
session announcing The Remission Circle. **Preview only.** Production will be a
GoHighLevel funnel step; this repo exists so the page can be reviewed at a URL.

## Do not edit this copy

`index.html` is generated from `landing-page.html` in the client project at
`1-projects/marketing-ops/Clients/roc-emails/launch-2026-08/landing-page/`.
Edit the source, regenerate, push. Two things differ from the source:

- image paths rewritten from `../headshots/` to `assets/`
- `noindex, nofollow` plus a disallow-all `robots.txt`, deliberate because the
  product has not launched and the page carries three physicians' names

## Known incomplete, on purpose

- `[DATE]` `[TIME]` `[TZ]` `[MONTH]` are placeholders and are meant to be visible
- the registration form is a styled placeholder awaiting the real GHL embed
- the copy is Anne Becheru's approved draft; a proposed cut from 19 sections to
  12 is still with her
